name: TC-PM-003 — 终态(ARCHIVED/CANCELLED)不允许继续操作 [P1]
description: 验证已归档和已终止状态不展示任何主流程action和终止入口

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const isTerminal = text.includes('已归档') || text.includes('已终止') || text.includes('ARCHIVED') || text.includes('CANCELLED'); const forbiddenActions = ['提交 Brief', '确认 Brief', '驳回 Brief', '发起评审', '提交审核', '确认通过', '确认驳回', '打回买手', '补充上传', '终止']; const foundForbidden = forbiddenActions.filter(a => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes(a) && !b.disabled); return !!btn; }); return { isTerminal, foundForbidden, forbiddenCount: foundForbidden.length }; })()
(() => { const terminateBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('终止') && !b.disabled); return { terminateBtnExists: !!terminateBtn }; })()

_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 进入已归档迭代详情
2. 验证不展示任何主流程action
3. 验证不展示终止入口
4. 同样验证已终止迭代
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 已归档：不展示提交/确认/驳回/审核/复核/上传/终止
2. 已终止：不展示任何主流程action
3. 两种终态均只读展示
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/权限与状态机
